overview: Concierge Knowledge and Service Concierge addresses staff search multiple approved sources manually and struggle to preserve permissions and version context in hospitality and tourism operations. The first proof of value uses approved attraction inventory, guest language and desk requests. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is first-contact concierge resolution, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

benefits.limits: Basis: design hypothesis. Depends on source quality and named decision owner

benefits.text: Measurable improvement in first-contact concierge resolution
benefits.limits: Basis: customer-specific hypothesis. No uplift promised; validate in controlled pilot

benefits.limits: Basis: design property. Applies only to events routed through the new workflow

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: approved attraction inventory, guest language and desk requests; define first-contact concierge resolution and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Hotel GM / Hospitality Revenue Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including golden question set with prompt-injection and authorization tests.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for first-contact concierge resolution
